dynamic.correlation_text:
Global Feedback Dynamics

Integrated data analysis reveals that the Thermal Anomaly (1.48ºC) acts as the primary engine for a cascade of imbalances. Oceanic warming (SST) not only degrades Marine Richness (OBIS) but also transfers latent energy to the atmosphere, fueling the exponential increase in Severe Events such as hurricanes and wildfires.
dynamic.exp_chartExtremos: Extreme aridity does not reduce floods; instead, dry and hydrophobic soils trigger flash floods during concentrated precipitation.
dynamic.exp_chartBiosfera: Biodiversity loss accelerates as soil integrity declines, eliminating the base of the natural regeneration capacity.
dynamic.exp_chartSismos: Increased seismic frequency suggests a crustal response to mass redistribution caused by polar ice melt.
dynamic.exp_chartOceanos: Marine thermal stress (SST) inversely correlates with species richness; warmer oceans are becoming biological deserts.
dynamic.exp_chartTemp: The thermal anomaly curve is the master indicator: every extra tenth of a degree injects billions of joules of energy into the system.
dynamic.exp_chartNoaaEcon: The financial cost of disasters follows the climate curve, proving that environmental inaction is immeasurably expensive.
dynamic.exp_chartAtmosfera: Loss of carbon sinks (forests) allows CO2 concentrations to spike, closing a thermal feedback loop.
dynamic.exp_chartGelo: Glacial mass loss is the sea-level stopwatch. Less ice means lower albedo and higher heat absorption.
dynamic.exp_chartIncendios: Increased kinetic energy in the atmosphere manifests in stronger winds and explosive evapotranspiration.
